A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VisionDirector/LGBench study, and all 10 pages are readable and comparable. Neither supplied PDF contains appendices or the separate supplementary material referenced in Section 4; the comparison covers all supplied content.

before.justification: v1 reports original LGBench evaluations, VisionDirector results on GenEval and ImgEdit, and planning and strategy ablations in Tables 2 and 4–7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark evaluations, VisionDirector results, and ablation outcomes in Tables 2 and 4–7.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same planner/editor/verifier architecture, eight-stage control procedure, micro-grid sampling, semantic rollback, and GRPO training objective.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same LGBench T2I/I2I coverage, GenEval generation tasks, and ImgEdit editing tasks. No evaluated dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 2, 4, 5, and 7 and Figure 5. No baseline or comparison strategy is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: The verifier confidence cutoff of 0.81, 80% task-success threshold, four T2I samples or one I2I edit per iteration, six-iteration cap, and 200-task ablation split are unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 4.4–4.5 retain the same GRPO, micro-grid, rollback, task-complexity, strategy, and qualitative analyses. Tables 6–7 and Figures 5–6 are unchanged; the referenced separate supplementary analyses are absent from both supplied files.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version provides performance uncertainty intervals, significance tests, or repeated-evaluation run counts.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are retained. Examples include VisionDirector's 0.94 GenEval score, 4.35 ImgEdit score, and the 4.2-to-3.1 planning-step comparison in Tables 4–6.

T1.justification: Equation (1), its token masking, group-normalized advantage, and KL regularization are identical. No mathematical definition, derivation, assumption, theorem, or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: LGBench, the training-free VisionDirector controller, and GRPO-based planning improvements. Performance and applicability claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of multi-goal failures, benefits of modular planning and verification, and future directions involving video, 3D, and human feedback remain unchanged in Sections 2.4, 5, and 7.

D1.justification: v3 adds an explicit project-page link on page 1, whereas v1 mentions a project page without providing its address. Other implementation disclosures are unchanged; the PDFs alone do not establish any new code or data release.

R1.justification: The same 42 reference entries and research-positioning passages are retained, including Section 6. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: v3 adds author-role footnotes identifying co-corresponding authors and the project lead, alongside the project-link line. Research prose, terminology, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The front-matter additions shift Figure 1 slightly and reflow text across pages 1–5, moving the Introduction's opening to page 2. All six figures and seven tables retain their content and design; pages 6–10 render identically.

improvement.justification: The project link improves discoverability and the author-role notes clarify attribution, but methods, evidence, explanations, and implementation details are otherwise unchanged. These limited front-matter additions and minor layout changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
